core need: Understand categories, verify providers/products and reach the correct pathway
demand evidence: 96.1% household mobile-phone access and 82.1% mobile broadband in 2024; broad normalized search interest
primary geography: South Africa mobile-first; George service detail; Western Cape pilot
best CTA: Use the evidence and verification navigator
key risk: Covert promotion, chat diagnosis, privacy leakage and normalized-index misrepresentation
validation action: Run 90-day consented digital pilot measuring broad intent, referral completion and trust

core need: Implement compliant longitudinal metabolic care with reliable pharmacy and monitoring workflows
demand evidence: High national obesity/diabetes burden; 2025 SA obesity guideline; 2026 enforcement increases governance need
primary geography: George/Garden Route pilot; Gauteng scale; Western Cape networks
best CTA: Request a governance and workflow qualification meeting
key risk: Product status, inducement, pharmacovigilance and POPIA failures
validation action: Interview 15–20 local providers and pilot a governance workflow with predefined audit metrics

core need: Non-stigmatising assessment, cost navigation, verified supply and structured monitoring
demand evidence: 2024 female obesity estimate 49.1%; 2.324m adults with diabetes; access limited to 15.5% scheme coverage
primary geography: George/Garden Route; Western Cape; Gauteng expansion
best CTA: Book clinician-led assessment/navigation; no prescription guaranteed
key risk: Affordability, stigma, ineligibility, contraindications, counterfeit supply and discontinuity
validation action: Conduct patient-journey interviews, live benefit checks, pharmacy price/stock checks and follow-up pilot

core need: Appearance maintenance, skin/hair triage, product and practitioner trust
demand evidence: ISAPS projected 99,184 South African aesthetic procedure events in 2024; not unique people or peptide demand
primary geography: George/Garden Route; Western Cape; Gauteng/KZN networks
best CTA: Explore compliant cosmetic education or find a verified clinician
key risk: Category crossover, illegal injectors, misleading claims, colourism and delayed diagnosis
validation action: Complete product classification and claims review; run consumer/channel interviews and cosmetic-only repeat pilot

core need: Fit-for-purpose peptide, analytical documentation, technical support and dependable procurement
demand evidence: R43.413bn national GERD in 2023/24; named peptide-relevant nodes; no peptide spend denominator
best CTA: Submit an institutional RFQ with sequence, grade, quantity and intended use
key risk: Lumpy demand, procurement friction, in-house/foreign competitors and RUO diversion
validation action: Target 25–40 labs, complete 12–15 interviews and obtain at least 10 genuine RFQs

core need: Respectful symptom assessment, minimum-necessary testing and multidisciplinary coordination
demand evidence: Growing older population and qualitative menopause need; no longevity/peptide market denominator
best CTA: Prepare for a registered clinician healthy-ageing/hormone-health assessment
key risk: Overtesting, unsupported anti-ageing claims, privacy, uncovered cost and unregistered products
validation action: Interview midlife adults and clinicians; test staged assessment comprehension and cost drop-off

core need: Injury triage, rehabilitation navigation, provider verification and clean-sport safety
demand evidence: Selected South African injury and supplement studies plus organised-event touchpoints; not peptide demand
primary geography: Western Cape clubs; Gauteng gyms; KZN endurance corridor
key risk: Experimental-evidence extrapolation, anti-doping liability, gym supply and urgency pressure
validation action: Adult-only research separating injury pathway, supplement behaviour, peptide awareness and competition status

core need: Understand risks, registration and appropriate professional routes
demand evidence: SAHPRA reports growing unlawful online/gym/informal supply; visibility is not legal market demand
best CTA: Check the official register, report suspected products and seek appropriate registered care
key risk: Unregistered supply, contamination, unsupported claims, diversion and severe reputational exposure
validation action: Monitor safety enquiries and reports only; no product validation or consumer supply
